summary: Extends the PCE Communication Protocol so a stateful PCE can ask a path computation client to hand over control of an LSP that was configured locally. The client can then delegate that LSP to the PCE, which may modify its attributes such as its path.

eli5.summary: A kid with a toy train set lets a parent take over the controls for a while. This lets a router hand control of a network path to a central planner.

questions: how does a pce request control of an lsp
what is lsp delegation in pcep
